market.method: TECHCET slurry $2.0B (2024) x ~28% Cu/barrier share (est.) = ~$0.56B; cross-check report $0.58B; other reports $1.1-1.2B

value.logic: ~$150B/yr advanced-logic wafer value (TSMC ~$120B 2025, ~74% at <=7nm, + others) x 0.1% yield from less Cu corrosion/dishing/BTA residue = ~$150M (est.)
value.revenue_logic: royalty ~3% x ~$170M of Cu slurry using it (~25% of 2032 market) = ~$5M, or chelator sold to slurry maker
value.margin_logic: tiny volume, high-purity specialty or license

trend.drivers: more CMP steps for GAA, backside power, 3D NAND, hybrid bonding; TECHCET CMP consumables 8.6%/yr to 2029

competition.notes: Slurry makers own formulas and fab quals; glycine/citrate + BTA standard. Entry only via a slurry maker. China (Anji) growing fast.

lab.synth: catalog or 1-2 step custom (amino-acid/azole chelators), 3 variants
lab.test: Cu static etch + removal rate on blanket Cu wafers (200 mm benchtop polisher), ASTM G59 polarization, XPS residue; univ. CMP lab (e.g. Clarkson, U. Arizona)
lab.logic: 4-6 wk synth + 4 wk polishing; 3 x ~$5k synth + ~$15k wafers (~$50-100 ea) and polisher time

sale.gates: slurry maker eval 6-12 mo; fab qual on patterned wafers + PCN 12-24 mo
